import json,time,hashlib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from puremacro.models import calibrate_capital_hank,solve_hank_reduced_policy
import puremacro.models.hank_nonlinear_continuation as nc
record={'case':'original_integrated_coarse_failure','calibration':dict(n_a=10,n_b=10,a_max=100.,b_max=15.),'distribution_rank':12,'marginal_rank':48,'krylov_steps':80,'shock_std':1e-4,'innovations':[-1e-6,2e-6,0.],'options':dict(horizons=[4,8,16],branch_depths=[1,2],horizon_tolerance=1e-6,branching_tolerance=1e-6,tolerance=1e-8),'corners':[],'source_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256(Path('puremacro/models/'+name+'.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['hank_capital','hank_reduction','hank_nonlinear_continuation']}}
ss=calibrate_capital_hank(**record['calibration']);p=solve_hank_reduced_policy(ss,distribution_rank=12,marginal_rank=48,krylov_steps=80)
original=nc.solve_hank_nonlinear_continuation

def logged(*a,**kw):
 start=time.perf_counter();result=original(*a,**kw);entry=dict(horizon=kw.get('horizon'),branch_depth=kw.get('branch_depth'),seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,diagnostics=result.diagnostics);record['corners'].append(entry)
 print('corner',entry['horizon'],entry['branch_depth'],entry['seconds'],result.converged,result.diagnostics['optimizer_message'],result.diagnostics['market_residual_max_abs'],flush=True)
 Path('/tmp/puremacro-controls-capital-adaptive-original.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2));return result

nc.solve_hank_nonlinear_continuation=logged
start=time.perf_counter()
try:
 result=nc.simulate_hank_nonlinear(p,np.array(record['innovations']),horizons=(4,8,16),branch_depths=(1,2),horizon_tolerance=1e-6,branching_tolerance=1e-6,tolerance=1e-8,keep_trees=True)
 record.update(converged=result.converged,seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,diagnostics=result.diagnostics)
 print('FINISHED',record['seconds'],result.converged,result.diagnostics,flush=True)
except nc.HANKContinuationAccuracyError as exc:
 result=exc.result;record.update(converged=False,seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,error=str(exc),diagnostics=result.diagnostics)
 np.savez_compressed('/tmp/puremacro-controls-capital-adaptive-original-failure.npz',distributions=result.tree.distributions,post_distributions=result.post_distributions,expected_marginals=result.expected_marginals,marginal_values=result.marginal_values,aggregate_states=result.aggregate_states,aggregate_coordinates=result.aggregate_coordinates,prices=result.prices.to_numpy(),price_columns=result.prices.columns.to_numpy(dtype=str))
 print('FAILED',record['seconds'],result.diagnostics,flush=True)
Path('/tmp/puremacro-controls-capital-adaptive-original.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
